name: Call Sheet
description: Scene-by-scene story play on its own page. Pick a persona and a cast from your library, describe the story, and play it one scene at a time: the main model proposes each scene (where, who is present, what it is for) and you edit, reroll or accept it; you give short instructions and the story writes your character's turn and the reply; scenes end only when you say so, and a frozen summary carries each one forward. Call Sheet builds every prompt itself, so no chat preset or setting applies. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Call Sheet.
